Bill.BriefDescription: Concerning fiduciary duties of debt adjusters.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to fiduciary duties of debt adjusters; and addinga new section to chapter 18.28 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 18.28 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: A debt adjuster has a fiduciary relationship with the debtor, andeach debt adjuster is subject to all requirements for fiduciariesotherwise applicable under state law.
